title: Coordinate Hopf identities of an arbitrary affine group scheme
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $H$ an affine group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. Write $C=k[H]=\Gamma(H,\mathcal O_H)$, so $H=\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. With tensor products of commutative algebras as in [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property], the pullbacks of multiplication, identity and inverse give $k$-algebra maps $\Delta:C\to C\otimes_k C$, $\epsilon:C\to k$, and $S:C\to C$. They satisfy
$$(\Delta\otimes1)\Delta=(1\otimes\Delta)\Delta,\qquad (\epsilon\otimes1)\Delta=(1\otimes\epsilon)\Delta=1_C,$$
under the tensor associativity and unit identifications. If $\mu:C\otimes_k C\to C$ is multiplication and $u:k\to C$ is the structure map, then
$$\mu(S\otimes1)\Delta=\mu(1\otimes S)\Delta=u\epsilon.$$
Thus, for every $c\in C$, any finite tensor presentation $\Delta(c)=\sum c_{(1)}\otimes c_{(2)}$ satisfies
$$\sum S(c_{(1)})c_{(2)}=\epsilon(c)1_C=\sum c_{(1)}S(c_{(2)}).$$
All three maps preserve products and units; in particular $S(cd)=S(c)S(d)$ and $S(1)=1$. No finite-type, smoothness, reducedness, commutativity of the group law, or finite-dimensionality hypothesis on $H$ or $C$ is imposed.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: apply the instance at Affine.lean:337-343 with R = CommRingCat.of k and G = H; it gives HopfAlgebra k Gamma(H, top). The construction transports the given group operations along H.isoSpec and algSpec.fullyFaithful (lines 339-343), so these are the given coordinate maps, not newly chosen operations. One declaration per explicit axiom consequence: Coalgebra.coassoc and Coalgebra.rTensor_counit_comp_comul / lTensor_counit_comp_comul (Mathlib/RingTheory/Coalgebra/Basic.lean:82,84,86); Bialgebra.counitAlgHom and comulAlgHom (Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Basic.lean:122,127); HopfAlgebra.mul_antipode_rTensor_comul and mul_antipode_lTensor_comul (Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Basic.lean:71,74), sum_antipode_mul_eq_algebraMap_counit and sum_mul_antipode_eq_algebraMap_counit (:103,108); HopfAlgebra.antipodeAlgHom (Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Convolution.lean:80). Read these source passages and the equivalence in Mathlib/Algebra/Category/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:199-219. The sum identities use any Coalgebra.Repr of Delta(c).
